title.en: HR Already at Ceiling, Barely 0.5 km In

tip.en: You hit 160 bpm here on a slight downhill at 0.5 km — that's already at your recent 8-run maximum HR, with 3 km still ahead. Your system came in hot today; the terrain wasn't the cause.
tip.zh: 仅0.5公里处心率已达160次/分，这正是近8次跑步的最高心率纪录，而此时路面还是略微下坡。今天身体状态本身就偏热，并非地形所致。

title.en: 8% Ramp Pushes HR into Uncharted Territory

tip.en: A short 8.3% pitch at 1.1 km drives HR to 170 — 10 bpm above anything in your recent history. This run is exposing a fatigue or illness tax that the flat stretches were already hinting at.
tip.zh: 1.1公里处8.3%的短坡将心率推至170次/分，比近期所有跑步记录高出10次。这段跑步暴露出疲劳或身体欠佳的代价，而之前的平路段已初现端倪。

title.en: 178 bpm on Flat Ground — the Clearest Alarm of the Run
title.zh: 平路178次/分——本次跑步最明确的警报

tip.en: You reach 178 bpm here on essentially level terrain at an average pace — no hill, no sprint to explain it. Against a recent-history ceiling of 160, this is an 18 bpm overshoot that signals your body was fighting something well beyond normal training load today.
tip.zh: 此处在近乎平坦的路面以正常配速跑步，心率却达到178次/分——没有坡度，没有冲刺，无法用外部因素解释。对比近期最高160次的记录，这18次/分的超出说明今天身体承受的压力已远超正常训练负荷。

title.en: Forced Walk: Body Overrides the Plan
title.zh: 被迫步行：身体否决了计划

tip.en: Pace collapses to 12+ min/km at 3.2 km with HR still at 169 — this is a walk, not a cool-down jog. The fact that HR stays elevated even as pace craters confirms the system was genuinely overloaded, not just tired legs.
tip.zh: 3.2公里处配速骤降至12分钟以上/公里，而心率仍维持在169次/分——这是步行，而非缓跑。配速崩塌而心率依然高企，证实了身体系统真实过载，而非仅仅是腿部疲劳。

title.en: Three-Minute Walk and HR Still Won't Drop
title.zh: 步行三分钟心率仍居高不下

tip.en: Two minutes into the walk, HR has only drifted from 169 to 141 — a sluggish recovery that mirrors the blunted cardiac recovery seen when the body is fighting illness or accumulated fatigue. Treat this run as a data point, not a failure, and monitor resting HR tomorrow before deciding on your next session.
tip.zh: 步行约两分钟后，心率仅从169缓降至141，恢复速度迟缓，这与身体在抵抗疾病或积累性疲劳时心脏恢复迟钝的表现一致。将这次跑步视为一个数据信号而非失败，明天晨起先测安静心率，再决定下次训练计划。
